text: The purpose of this Motion is to have City Council appoint a new public member from the Aboriginal Community to fill a current vacancy on the Heritage Toronto Board due to the resignation of Lena Recollet. The Heritage Toronto Board is composed of 25 members, consisting of 4 members of City Council, 19 public members, 1 public member from the Aboriginal community and 1 public member nominated by the Toronto Historical Association. At its meeting on November 7, 8 and 9, 2017, City Council modified the appointment process for Heritage Toronto by authorizing Heritage Toronto staff and the City Clerk to shortlist, interview, and recommend candidates to the Civic Appointments Committee for appointment to the Heritage Toronto Board by City Council. City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Gene Jamieson as the public member from the Aboriginal Community to the Toronto Heritage Board at pleasure of Council for a term of office ending on February 4, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.
